category.leaf: 适配 Pro Max 机型超清高透钢化屏幕保护膜

description: 适配大尺寸 Pro Max 机型、超清高透、边缘精准贴合、对齐托盘一次落位

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, mist white #F2F4F7 for the feature screen, glacier wash #E4EFF2 for scene and install screens, graphite slate #1B1F24 for the two edge-lit demonstration screens; no gradient scenery other than the open glacier horizon
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool 6000K studio light, large front softbox key with a fill card, one narrow rim strip tracing every glass edge, low contrast elsewhere, soft contact shadows, controlled single streak specular on the film surface, no coloured cast on the glass
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte mist-white board #F2F4F7 and brushed graphite slate #1B1F24, plus one narrow ribbed glass strip used as a refractive foreground band
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, held entirely off-image so every headline and label plate inside the frame stays blank
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line glyph tiles in #1B1F24 on mist white #F2F4F7, rounded rectangle frames, each paired with an empty label plate, no rendered characters
styleLock.presentationRules: the film always reads as an optically clear sheet bounded by one bright edge line; the phone is always a generic unbranded large-screen body with a blank screen and no badge or camera island identity; product scale and centring stable across the set
noDrift: no rendered brand marks, letters or numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent crisp optically-clear tech-accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, mist white #F2F4F7, graphite black #1B1F24 and one glacier-teal accent #6FB4C2 with an open glacier-wash horizon #E4EFF2; cool neutral studio grade; modern geometric sans-serif kept off-image so every headline and label plate stays blank; single-weight thin-line icon tiles only; background system alternates pure white, mist white, glacier wash and graphite slate; lighting system is a cool 6000K front softbox with a narrow rim strip tracing every glass edge, low contrast, soft contact shadows and one controlled streak specular, no coloured cast on the glass; the film always reads as an optically clear sheet with one bright edge line and the phone always reads as a generic unbranded large-screen body; stable product scale and placement; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no rendered brand marks or letters or numbers, no tinted or coloured glass.

provenance.notes: 源 6 张官方主图逐图事实：001 白底零售盒与扇形展开的透明膜片、彩色安装对齐框同框，盒面排布细线特性图标与圆环徽标；002 浅蓝底上通用机身正面 3/4、一片膜悬于屏前、左右各三枚细线图标配英文特性字；003 淡蓝紫地貌背景，膜片立于细密砂丘前做超清折射演示，底部一条条纹玻璃压边，顶部两行英文标题；004 机角倒角与传感器开孔微距，边缘三道发光弧线示意精准贴合，左上英文短语；005 深色机身斜置于浅蓝底，美工刀尖划过膜面溅火星，顶部两行英文主张；006 俯拍平铺，透明对齐托盘压在机身上，指尖按落膜片，白色英文标题。品类判定以图为准：主体是透明钢化玻璃膜片，机身只是通用无品牌大屏占位件（leaf 写通用适配 Pro Max 机型，不写任何具体品牌型号与标识），对齐框属安装配件，故归「手机数码 / 手机配件」，未采用源平台类目挂法。已剥离内容：零售盒与图内全部字标、系列名、原平台店铺字样、英文标题原句、圆环徽标与星级/徽章类社会证明；特性图标标签一律改为空白标签板，厚度、硬度、透光率、件数等不可验证数字与主张不入稿，改由使用方自填或留空；片数不入稿。与库内既有膜类模版逐镜比对：既有两套为 10 镜深色系结构，本套为 6 镜浅色系（白底盒装同框、图标环列、锋刃痛点、冰原透景、倒角微距、托盘俯拍），分镜不同构，非通版重复。
